ZH: 这下好了，现在我们人手不足。

EN: Worked till they dropped. Such dedication!
ZH: 干活干到倒下为止。可真有奉献精神！

EN: Must have been a heck of a workout.
ZH: 那想必是一场要命的锻炼。
嘿，肥料又多了一份！这话说得太早了吧？

EN: At least they passed away peacefully, at home.
ZH: 至少他们在家里安静地去世了。

EN: So much for the finest medical care Vault-Tec could provide.
ZH: 避难所科技引以为傲的顶级医疗，也不过如此。

EN: Hey you! No slacking on the production line!
ZH: 嘿，你！在生产线上不要偷懒！

EN: Looks like I've got a eulogy to broadcast.
ZH: 看来我有篇悼词要广播了。

EN: I hope they at least donated their body to science.
ZH: 希望他们至少把遗体捐给了科学研究。

EN: I'd take care of the body myself, but the smell might be a bit much.
ZH: 我倒是想亲自处理这具尸体，可那味道恐怕有点儿受不了。

EN: We've got a serious sanitation problem in here!
ZH: 我们这有一个严重的卫生问题！

EN: Get that corpse out of here! It'll contaminate everything!
ZH: 把尸体弄出来！它会污染一切！

EN: To think, I've finally found my dream job!
ZH: 想想看，我终于找到了我理想的工作！

EN: The G.O.A.T. was right! This is the perfect job for me!
ZH: G.O.A.T.测试说得没错！这对我来说是完美的工作！
努力工作就是快乐工作！

EN: Hope there's a chance for overtime!
This place would fall apart without me.
ZH: 没有我，这地方非得乱套不可。

EN: What can I say? I'm great at my job.
ZH: 我能说什么呢？我超级擅长我的工作。

EN: I can't imagine doing anything else in the Vault.
ZH: 我无法想象在避难所里做其他的工作。

EN: The Overseer really made a smart move assigning me here.
ZH: 监督者分配我来这边真是明智之举。

EN: So glad I got assigned here!
This really is the perfect job for me.
ZH: 这对我来说真是最完美的工作。

EN: I have the perfect work assignment. Thanks, Overseer!
ZH: 我有一份完美的工作分配。谢谢你啦，监督者！

EN: This room is running at peak efficiency... thanks to me!
ZH: 这间房正以最高效率运转……多亏了我！

EN: If I weren't working here, production wouldn't be nearly so good.
ZH: 要是我不在这儿干活，产量可远没有这么好。

EN: Every day's a good day when I'm on the job!
ZH: 只要上了班，天天都是好日子！

EN: With me working here, maximum efficiency is guaranteed!
ZH: 有我在这里工作，保证效率达到最高！

EN: Don't worry you've got ME on the job.
What a perfect work assignment for me...
ZH: 对我来说是一份完美的工作分配……

EN: Have I mentioned recently how much I love my job?
ZH: 我最近有没有提到我是多么热爱我的工作？

EN: Nobody trains harder than I do. Nobody.
ZH: 没有人比我更努力地训练了。没有人。

EN: I knew being a total gun nut would come in handy some day!
ZH: 我就知道成为一个爱枪狂人有一天会派上用场！

EN: I could sling drinks all day!
ZH: 我可以整天调酒都不腻！

EN: Preparing food is my lifelong dream!
ZH: 做饭就是我毕生的梦想！

EN: Poker or blackjack - I'm the best dealer there is!
ZH: 扑克还是21点——我可是最棒的发牌员！

EN: That teacher of the year award is so close, I can feel it!
ZH: 年度最佳教师奖近在咫尺，我能感觉得到！

EN: I'm the fittest person in this Vault. And always will be.
ZH: 我是这个避难所里体质最好的人。永远都会是。

EN: With me on the job, this Vault will never go dark!
ZH: 有我在这里工作，避难所永远不会停电！

EN: My technical expertise keeps this place running.
ZH: 我的技术专长使这个地方正常运转。

EN: Could I get any stronger? Probably not!
ZH: 我还能变得更强吗？大概不能吧！

EN: So great to be putting my green thumb to use!
ZH: 能把我的园艺天赋派上用场，真是太棒了！

EN: If relaxing were a job, I'd be Employee of the Month!
ZH: 如果休息也算工作，我肯定是月度最佳员工！

EN: If I can't heal you, nobody can!
ZH: 我要是治不好你，那就没人治得好了！

EN: I have achieved the perfect mixture! I'd a soda genius!
ZH: 我调出了完美的配方！我真是苏打水天才！

EN: I'm so good, I could contact China. If it's, you know... still there.
ZH: 我太厉害了，都能联系上中国。当然……如果它还在的话。

EN: My experiments could change all our lives for the better!
ZH: 我的实验能改变我们的生活，让它变得更好！
论囤杂物，没人比得过我！

EN: I can turn anything into drinkable water! Anything...
ZH: 我能把任何东西变成饮用水！任何东西……

EN: Tastes like spring water, thanks to me!
ZH: 喝起来像泉水一样甘甜，多亏了我！

EN: Seriously? We have to work together?
ZH: 不是吧？非得跟你一起共事？

EN: Look who's here to show off. Again.
ZH: 瞧瞧谁来炫耀了。又来了。

EN: The temptation to grab a weapon and shoot you is overwhelming.
ZH: 抢过武器崩了你的诱惑，实在难以抗拒。

EN: No amount of alcohol can make me like you.
ZH: 喝再多酒也不能让我喜欢上你。

EN: Ugh. Just go away. I'm losing my appetite.
ZH: 呃。走开行吗？我都快没胃口了。

EN: Take a hike. You're ruining my luck.
ZH: 一边儿去。你都快把我的好运搅没了。

EN: I'm just here to learn. Not put up with this know-it-all.
ZH: 我只是来学习的，不是来受这个自以为是家伙的气的。

EN: If only I had the endurance to deal with idiots like you.
ZH: 要是我有足够的耐力来应付你这种白痴就好了。

EN: This is serious work we're doing in here. So why are you here?
ZH: 我们在这里做着正经工作。你在这里干什么？

EN: Someone get this incompetent imbecile out of here.
ZH: 谁来把这个无能的低能儿赶走。

EN: Yes, yes. You're super strong and awesome. We get it.
ZH: 是是。你超级强壮又超级厉害。我们知道了。

EN: If I could, I'd grow a Venus flytrap to eat you alive.
ZH: 如果可以，我真想种一株捕蝇草，把你活活吃掉。

EN: Don't you have someplace else to be? Like out in the Wasteland?
ZH: 你没有别的地方可以去吗？比如说废土上？

EN: I'm tempted to kill you, but they'd probably save your life.
ZH: 我很想杀了你，但他们可能会救你的命。

EN: No amount of sugar can sweeten our relationship. I despise you.
ZH: 再多的糖也无法让我们的关系甜起来。我鄙视你。

EN: Maybe I can send out an S.O.S. and get saved from your stupidity.
ZH: 也许我可以发个求救信号，让人把我从你的愚蠢中解救出去。

EN: Anyone ever tell you you're like an experiment gone?
ZH: 有人告诉过你，你就像一个出差错的实验吗？

EN: I'd lock you in storage if I could. Forever.
ZH: 如果我能的话，我会把你锁在储藏室里。永远。

EN: I'd drown them in a water tank if I could get away with it...
ZH: 要是能不被追究，我真想把他们淹死在水箱里……

EN: If only we had the technology to remove the impurities from... you.
ZH: 要是我们有技术能清除……你这个杂质……就好了。

EN: A general atomics international mark 4. That's what I am, you seem to be a human.
ZH: 我是通用原子国际4型机器人，你应该是个人类吧。

EN: My temporal sensors went out in the Great War. That must have been a week ago at least.
ZH: 我的时间传感器在大战中受损了，估计至少是一周前的事了。

EN: Our finger inventory's in a sorry state.
ZH: 我们的手指库存真是惨不忍睹。

EN: Now would you prefer a dressing of high quality synthetic fibers, classic cotton,  or a comforting synthetic-cotton blend?
ZH: 你想要哪种绷带？优质合成纤维、经典全棉还是舒适的合成棉混纺？

EN: Where are you from again? Never been there myself. Hope to go someday soon.
ZH: 你是从哪儿来的？我从未去过那里，希望有一天能去看看。

EN: Now, don't be afraid. A little snip-snip,  and it will all be over.
ZH: 好了，别害怕。咔嚓咔嚓，小剪两下，一切就都结束了。

EN: If you've got a clog that's full of muck, trust Abraxo to get it unstuck. It's VERY poisonous.
ZH: 如果你的下水道堵满了污物，放心交给艾巴索疏通——记住，它毒性非常强！

EN: Pardon me, could I help you have a better day?
ZH: 打扰一下，我能帮你度过美好的一天吗？

EN: I'm only going to harvest your organs.
ZH: 我只是要摘取你的器官而已。
我们把产量提到最高了！干得漂亮！
